## Appearance

Paul Irving has dark blue eyes that are large and expressive, along with delicate, refined features. Though initially small for his age, by age thirteen he grew very tall for his years, eventually becoming a splendid six-foot-tall man. His early naturally curly hair, described as chestnut or brown, later gave way to close-cropped brown locks.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), +5 more_

## Personality

A manly and cleanly child, Paul Irving is considered a genius who behaves as a perfect little gentleman and holds his own in games. He possesses an imaginative nature alongside occasional flashes of uncanny insight.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P32](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P52](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0052), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P54](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0054)_

## History

Paul Irving was once a young schoolboy in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who had lost his mother three years prior. He was an imaginative student under [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's instruction, comforting her early on with wild orchids and sharing stories of his imaginary shore friends and rock people. As his teacher, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spent considerable time with Paul, listening to his creative thoughts and visiting [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with him, where he bonded with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) over their shared dream-people. Paul was distressed upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was resigning from her teaching post to attend college. After his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), returned to marry Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), Paul expressed excitement about moving to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston). Years later, he returned as a guest to attend [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's wedding at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +36 more_

## Quotes

> "and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . ."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)

> “Yes; but if dryads are foolish they must take the consequences, just as if they were real people,” said Paul gravely. “Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.”
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)

> "I’ve eaten enough to make anyone grow. I do hope, now that I’ve begun, I’ll keep on till I’m as tall as father. He is six feet, you know, Miss Lavendar."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P24](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0024)

> "I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had. I think it’s a pity you haven’t any boys of your own."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)

> "you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here! Come right in. Father, this is my beautiful teacher. You know, father."
>
> — Paul Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--paul-irving.md)

Paul is a pupil in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's schoolroom, and the two quickly become fast friends. They bond over a shared imaginative nature, frequently taking walks together to discuss childhood worries, rock people, and their thoughts on life. Paul is deeply distressed when he learns that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is resigning her teaching post to attend college.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), +14 more_
